root_idea.summary: The root centers on ease and smooth passage, especially the easy continuation of something through the throat.
root_idea.development: The concrete sense of easy swallowing extends to facilitation, permissibility, access, and agreeable reception. Classical usage also records related branches involving succession and likeness, while keeping those branches lexically distinct.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form IV verb, normalized to the classical perfect citation form.
Quran-attested active participle presented under its singular dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: To swallow; to take food or drink down into the throat, especially easily and agreeably.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran it occurs with an object that is swallowed, in a negative construction expressing that the object is scarcely swallowable. The ease component may therefore be contextually denied.

senses.definition: Easy and agreeable to swallow or drink; palatable and not choking.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle applied to beverage, food, or other ingestible material, describing its easy descent through the throat and pleasant swallowability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass easily and agreeably through the throat; of beverage, wine, or food, to be easy to swallow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I usage, normally said of something being swallowed or passing down the throat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter a land while finding a place or opportunity of entry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative imperative construction derived from the notion of easy entrance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be allowable or lawful; for an act or matter to be acceptable as permitted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative usage, including the construction سَاغَ لَهُ مَا فَعَلَ, ‘what he did was allowable to him.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the day, to be or become easy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative usage said of the day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the earth, to sink with someone and swallow or enclose him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A recorded figurative construction with the earth as subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to become separate, run off, and go far away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage explicitly said of a she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make what someone has attained pleasant or agreeable to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II figurative usage, with the person receiving the benefit commonly expressed by لَهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something clear, available, allowable, lawful, or free to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II usage of leaving an acquired matter or property unobstructed or at a person's disposal; the source records both the sense of making it clear and that of making it lawful or free.
A figurative Form II construction with لَهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grant someone respite, treat him gently, or refrain from hurrying him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative use, literally framed as making a choking thing easy to swallow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To complete an affair or accomplish one's objective by means of someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when the acquisition of the final person or item completes a required number or fulfills the intended need.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be born with one's brother or immediately after him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported usage allows either birth in the same delivery or birth directly following the brother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person born immediately after another, especially a sibling; by extension, one who follows another closely in birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may refer to a sibling or a non-sibling, and may also denote several people born after someone in the same delivery or in immediate succession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A counterpart of the same cast, mould, form, or proportion; something fashioned like another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded as an alternative interpretation of هٰذَا سَوْغُ هٰذَا, with a possible dialectal relationship to صَوْغٌ noted in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that helps something choking enter the throat and pass down it, such as water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a means or aid that facilitates swallowing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Official permission or authorization to take what is due to someone, with facilitation of its acquisition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A post-Classical administrative usage, especially associated with an authority's permission to obtain a rightful due.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or way of easy entrance or passage, especially for food or drink into the throat; figuratively, a way or opportunity of entry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative extension can refer to an entrance into land or to any available passage or avenue.
